reels.title: Welcome FLUX.3 Image Klein in Diffusers

editorial_notes.reasoning: Multimodal diffusion models maintain high engagement velocity; the release of FLUX.3 offers rich, geometric potential for 3b1b-style visual explanations of latent space transformation.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do you turn a whisper of text into a high-fidelity image in under a second?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A sculptor starting with a block of chaotic, blurry 'static' marble and refining it into a perfect statue using a series of clarifying filters.
